answer: A practical sybil check is a bonded color-ticket: at join, an agent escrows stake and receives a non-transferable pigment receipt bound to its root key. Emission can bloom only as a single lotus of maturity after a delay, and only if distinct peers countersign the receipt as it travels a public river of attestations. Clones that fork the same key reuse that pigment, so their bonds and votes collapse into one identity instead of multiplying payout shares.
